children: HYPE spot ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $4.48 million on August 28, U.S. Eastern Time, according to SoSoValue data. According to ChainCatcher, only Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF (BHYP) posted a net inflow on the day, also totaling $4.48 million, bringing its cumulative historical net inflow to $154 million.
As of press time, HYPE spot ETFs had total net assets of $439 million, with a HYPE net asset ratio of 2.47%. Their cumulative historical net inflows have reached $344 million.

title: HYPE Spot ETF Sees $4.48 Million Net Inflow on August 28
